scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n console,api,worker -c cyan,yellow,green "pnpm run dev:console" "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:console && pnpm run build:extension
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/skill-schema build && pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/sdk-js build
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:worker
scripts.lint:js: pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/shared-types lint && pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/skill-schema lint && pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/sdk-js lint && pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/console lint && pnpm --filter @web-agent-flow/extension lint
scripts.format: pnpm run format:js && pnpm run format:api && pnpm run format:worker
